scope: Q06/R12 sign-out confirmation focus and repeat/dismissal guard
M15 explicit sign-out retry and signed-out entry focus
before: Activating Sign out natively disables its focused action and leaves BODY while waiting and after an injected failure.
implementation: Keep Sign out and Cancel natively focusable while pending using established modal aria-disabled/busy styling. Shared Dialog closeDisabled presents and guards the header Close and its Escape/backdrop routes.
Add synchronous inFlight guard for repeated confirmation and dismissal before pending renders. Clear it on settlement. Existing library-save exclusion and backend sign-out protocol remain unchanged.

Preserve ordinary Cancel/opener return. On failure keep the user's current dialog focus for explicit retry; on success the existing connection page auto-focuses Jellyfin server. No delayed focus effect.
decision: Mechanical correction following the established pending-dialog pattern from PR86/87; root source review, no independent paired proposal/review claimed.

dialogs.title: Sign out of Jellyfin?
paragraphs: Playback will stop and unsaved news setup and script edits will be discarded. Your saved profiles, DJs, provider keys and recordings stay on this Mac.

Signing out pauses automatic news preparation and stops in-progress news and voice generation. A request already sent may still finish or incur a charge. After signing in, resume automatic preparation in News bucket → Settings.

final.disconnectAccounting: Two IPC attempts: one held and deliberately failed before operation, then one explicit successful retry. Repeated Return/Space dispatch no extra call. Ordinary Cancel makes none.

checks.build: Full production build including TypeScript passed on final source; bundle hashes revalidated.
checks.native: Cancel/opener, focused busy action, duplicate suppression, pending Cancel/Escape/Close, failure preserving later Close focus, explicit retry and signed-out server focus pass. Busy actions retain a solid visible outline.
checks.playback: Actual disposable saved duplicate queue/current occurrence and options remain identical across all final snapshots. UI transport is paused before sign-out and absent on the signed-out form.
checks.processes: Before/final observers exit0; exact owned server PID24417 stopped and session86154 exits143.

fixture.input: Native CUA only; Playwright launch/read-only observation. Distinct copied Electron identity avoids live development app.
fixture.runtime: Production renderer/preload, copied instrumented actual main/storage, disposable safeStorage/catalog, null shared-key adapter, stopped scheduler and muted media.
fixture.writes: No HTTP write or provider/external request. Successful retry executes existing disconnect against disposable protected connection/local state only.
fixture.failure: Post-guard IPC completion gate injects disconnect failure before operation, not actual credential-removal or preparation-pause storage failure.

acceptance.Q06: Review for remaining radio/setup/prepared-take controls and conditional states.

limits: No VoiceOver/AT, listener, audible, live-provider/server, platform matrix, release, unit or deferred viewport/zoom acceptance.
No new paid-preparation cancellation, active speech, provider-key-write overlap or library-save race proof; unchanged backend protocol retains its prior scoped evidence.
Pending backdrop follows unchanged inspected Shared Dialog path; no separate new native backdrop click.
Dated source maps and provenance audit remain dated.

sourceTraceSupplement.text: The sign-out confirmation keeps Sign out, Cancel and Close keyboard-focusable while showing that they are unavailable during the request. Repeated confirmation or dismissal cannot duplicate or interrupt it. A failed sign-out keeps the error and current dialog focus for explicit retry. Ordinary Cancel restores its opener without signing out. Success opens the signed-out form with focus on Jellyfin server.

| M15 | I can sign out without leaving paid work running | Automatic preparation is enabled, or text/voice generation is pending, and I want to leave the account | Review Sign out, cancel or confirm, then reopen and sign in again | Cancel changes nothing and restores its opener; pending Sign out/Cancel/Close remain focusable but visibly unavailable, repeated confirm/dismiss keys cannot duplicate or interrupt the request, failure keeps current dialog focus for retry, and success focuses the signed-out server field; confirmation discards only unsaved radio drafts, pauses automatic preparation across profiles and cancels generation without replay; completed publications and saved settings/history/counts stay intact; signed-out startup and reconnect never resume preparation automatically; explicitly resume one profile after reviewing setup; failed pause or credential removal keeps a coherent connected account with visible recovery; a failed pause explains that preparation could not be paused and the listener is still signed in, with explicit sign-out retry |
